title: Four-panel vertical yonkoma comic
brief: Create a finished Japanese-style yonkoma (4-panel) gag comic in a tall 1:4 format, cute anime illustration style with clean lineart and soft cel shading. The heroine is Akane, an adult woman with long pink hair, pink eyes with heart-shaped pupils, wearing a white blouse and a pink apron; keep her design identical in all four panels. Classic structure: setup, development, twist, punchline.
lettering: Readable Japanese speech balloons, hand-lettered black Japanese text, natural kana and kanji.

panels.scene: Akane in her kitchen holds up a recipe card with sparkling eyes; flour bag, eggs and a mixing bowl on the counter; morning light.
panels.line: 今日こそ完璧なケーキを焼くぞ！

panels.scene: Akane whisks furiously, flour cloud everywhere, cream on her cheek, the bowl tilting; comic sweat drops and motion lines.
The oven door opens and a lopsided, puffed-up cake with a burnt top appears; Akane freezes in shock, smoke curls, dramatic shock lines.
Akane happily eats the burnt cake at the table with a fork, heart-shaped pupils glowing, little hearts floating; warm cozy lighting.

must_not: not a horizontal strip or a grid
not a different character design between panels
